description: Defines classes and structures related to the uplink plane handling in a Radio Unit, including notification interfaces for received symbols and PRACH windows, as well as handlers for capturing PRACH windows and processing uplink slots.

classes.name: ru_uplink_plane_rx_symbol_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifying about new uplink symbols and PRACH window data.

classes.name: ru_uplink_plane_handler
classes.description: Interface for handling PRACH occasions and uplink slot processing.

methods.name: on_new_uplink_symbol
methods.description: Notify the completion of an OFDM symbol with context, resource grid, and validity status.

methods.name: on_new_prach_window_data
methods.description: Notify that a PRACH window has been written in the buffer.

methods.name: handle_prach_occasion
methods.description: Request to capture a PRACH window starting at specified slot and symbol.

methods.name: handle_new_uplink_slot
methods.description: Request to process an uplink slot and store the processed data.
